title: कक्षा छ पूरा गरेका विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमताको अध्ययन {Study of Reading Comprehension of Students who have Completed Class Six}
nepali: शोधशीर्षक 	ः 	कक्षा ६ पूरा गरेका विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमताको अध्ययन शोधार्थी 	        ः     	दिव्यकला अधिकारी शोधनिर्देशक 	ः 	प्रा.डा. केदारप्रसाद शर्मा विभाग÷क्याम्पस 	ः 	नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभाग, विश्वविद्यालय क्याम्पस, त्रि.वि., कीर्तिपुर शैक्षिक वर्ष 	ः 	२०६१÷०६३ पृष्ठ सङ्ख्या	ः 	५४+१५ अध्याय 	ः 	पाँच शोधप्रक्रियाः प्रस्तुत शोधपत्र त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्काय नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभागअन्तर्गत एम.एड. नेपा.शि. ५९८ पाठ्यांशको प्रयोजनको लागि तयार पारिएको हो । कक्षा ६ पूरा गरेका विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमताको  अध्ययन गर्नु यस शोधकार्यको प्रमुख उद्देश्य हो । यसअन्तर्गत काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका निजी तथा सार्वजनिक विद्यालयमा अधययनरत विद्यार्थीहरूको स्थानीयता, लैङ्गिकता, विद्यालयको प्रकृति र भाषिक पृष्ठभूमिका आधारमा अध्ययन विश्लेषण गर्ने कार्य गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत शोधपत्रको लागि सामग्री सङ्कलन गर्ने क्रममा प्राथमिक स्रोतको रूपमा काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका पाँच–पाँचवटा निजी तथा सार्वजनिक विद्यालयका ५०–५० जना विद्यार्थीहरू गरी जम्मा दश वटा विद्यालयबाट १०० जना विद्यार्थीहरूलाई नमुनाको रूपमा लिइएको छ भने गौण सामग्रीका रूपमा पूर्वकार्यहरू, सन्दर्भ पुस्तकहरू, पत्रपत्रिकाहरू तथा विभिन्न लेखरचनाहरू रहेका छन् । पाँच अध्यायमा सङ्गठित प्रस्तुत शोधकार्यलाई क्रमशः शोधपरिचय, सैद्धान्तिक परिचय, व्याख्या तथा विश्लेषण, तुलनात्मक विश्लेषण र निष्कर्ष तथा सुझावहरूमा विभाजित छ । शोधनिष्कर्ष ः 	समग्र पठनबोध क्षमताको स्थितिमा विद्यार्थीहरूको क्षमतालाई प्रतिशतमा गणना गर्दा तथा मध्यमानलाई आधार मानी हेर्दा विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता सन्तोषजनक रहेको देखिन्छ । 	समग्र विद्यार्थीहरूको दृष्टांश र अदृष्टांश पठनबोध क्षमताको स्थितिलाई तुलनात्मक रूपमा विश्लेषण गर्दा दृष्टांश पठनबोध क्षमता अदृष्टांश पठनबोध क्षमताभन्दा केही सन्तोषजनक देखिन्छ । 	स्थानीयताका दृष्टिले नगरतर्फका विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता हेर्दा ५८ प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा माथि र ४२ प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा तल रहनुले नगरतर्फका विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता उच्च रहेको पाइन्छ भने गाउँतर्फ ४० प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा माथि र ६० प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा तल देखिनुले गाउँ तर्फका विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता निम्न रहेको पाइन्छ । 	लैङ्गिकताका दृष्टिले हेर्दा छात्र विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता हेर्दा ४० प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा माथि र ६० प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा तल रहनाले छात्र समूहका विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमता कमजोर देखिन्छ भने छात्रा विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमता मध्यमानभन्दा माथि ६० प्रतिशत र मध्यमानभन्दा तल ४० प्रतिशत विद्यार्थीहरू रहनाले  छात्रा विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमता उच्च रहेको देखिन्छ । 	विद्यालयको प्रकृतिका आधारमा हेर्दा निजी विद्यालयका विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा माथि बहुसङ्ख्यक र सार्वजनिक विद्यालयतर्फका विद्यार्थीहरू मध्यमानभन्दा तल बहुसङ्ख्यक रहनुले निजी विद्यालयका विद्यार्थीहरूको पठनबोध क्षमता सन्तोषजनक देखिन्छ भने सार्वजनिक विद्यालयतर्फका विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता निराशजनक देखिन्छ । 	भाषिक पृष्ठभूमिका आधारमा हेर्दा नेपाली मातृभाषी विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता उच्च रहेको देखिन्छ भने नेपाली विमातृभाषी विद्यार्थीहरूको समग्र पठनबोध क्षमता निम्न रहेको देखिन्छ ।
american_english:
Research title: A Study of the Reading Comprehension Ability of Students Who Have Completed Class Six
Researcher: Dibyakala Adhikari
Research adviser: Prof. Dr. Kedar Prasad Sharma
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2061/63
Number of pages: 54+15
Chapters: five
Research procedure: The present research paper has been prepared for the purpose of the M.Ed. Nepa. Shi. 598 course under the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.
Studying the reading comprehension ability of students who have completed class six is the main objective of this research work.
Under this, the work of studying and analyzing the students studying in private and public schools of the Kathmandu Valley has been done on the basis of locality, gender, nature of school and linguistic background.
In the course of collecting materials for the present research paper, 50–50 students from five private and five public schools of the Kathmandu Valley, 100 students from ten schools in total, have been taken as a sample as the primary source, while previous works, reference books, newspapers and various articles are the secondary materials.
The present research work, organized into five chapters, is divided respectively into research introduction, theoretical introduction, explanation and analysis, comparative analysis, and conclusions and suggestions.
Research findings:
When the students' ability is calculated in percentage in the situation of overall reading comprehension ability, and when it is looked at with the mean taken as the basis, the overall reading comprehension ability of the students is seen to be satisfactory.
When comparatively analyzing the situation of the seen-passage and unseen-passage reading comprehension ability of all the students, the seen-passage reading comprehension ability is seen to be somewhat more satisfactory than the unseen-passage reading comprehension ability.
In terms of locality, when the overall reading comprehension ability of the students on the urban side is looked at, 58 percent of students being above the mean and 42 percent of students below the mean means the overall reading comprehension ability of urban students is found to be high, while on the rural side 40 percent of students being above the mean and 60 percent of students below the mean means the overall reading comprehension ability of rural students is found to be low.
In terms of gender, when the overall reading comprehension ability of male students is looked at, 40 percent of students being above the mean and 60 percent of students below the mean shows the reading comprehension ability of the male group of students to be weak, while 60 percent of female students being above the mean and 40 percent of students below the mean shows the reading comprehension ability of female students to be high.
Looking on the basis of the nature of the school, the majority of private school students being above the mean and the majority of public school students being below the mean shows the reading comprehension ability of private school students to be satisfactory, while the overall reading comprehension ability of public school students is seen to be disappointing.
Looking on the basis of linguistic background, the overall reading comprehension ability of Nepali mother-tongue students is seen to be high, while the overall reading comprehension ability of non-Nepali-mother-tongue students is seen to be low.

Research title: A Study of the Reading Comprehension Competence of Pupils Who Have Completed Class Six
Researcher: Dibyakala Adhikari
Research supervisor: Prof. Dr Kedar Prasad Sharma
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur

Number of pages: 54+15

Research procedure: The present research paper has been prepared for the purpose of the M.Ed. Nepa. Shi. 598 course within the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.
To study the reading comprehension competence of pupils who have completed class six is the principal objective of this research work.
Under this, the task of studying and analysing the pupils studying in private and public schools of the Kathmandu Valley has been carried out on the basis of locality, gender, nature of school and linguistic background.
In the course of collecting material for the present research paper, 50 pupils each from five private and five public schools of the Kathmandu Valley, 100 pupils from ten schools in all, have been taken as the sample as the primary source, whilst previous works, reference books, newspapers and various articles constitute the secondary material.
The present research work, organised in five chapters, is divided respectively into research introduction, theoretical introduction, explanation and analysis, comparative analysis, and conclusions and suggestions.
Research conclusions:
When the competence of the pupils is computed as a percentage in respect of overall reading comprehension, and when it is viewed with the mean taken as the basis, the overall reading comprehension competence of the pupils is seen to be satisfactory.
When the position of the pupils' seen-passage and unseen-passage reading comprehension competence is analysed comparatively, the seen-passage reading comprehension competence is seen to be somewhat more satisfactory than the unseen-passage reading comprehension competence.
From the standpoint of locality, in looking at the overall reading comprehension competence of the pupils on the town side, the fact that 58 per cent of pupils stand above the mean and 42 per cent below the mean shows the overall reading comprehension competence of town pupils to be high, whereas on the village side the fact that 40 per cent of pupils stand above the mean and 60 per cent below the mean shows the overall reading comprehension competence of village pupils to be low.
From the standpoint of gender, in looking at the overall reading comprehension competence of the boy pupils, the fact that 40 per cent of pupils stand above the mean and 60 per cent below the mean shows the reading comprehension competence of the boys' group to be weak, whereas the fact that 60 per cent of the girl pupils stand above the mean and 40 per cent below the mean shows the reading comprehension competence of the girl pupils to be high.
Judged on the basis of the nature of the school, the fact that private school pupils are in the majority above the mean while public school pupils are in the majority below the mean shows the reading comprehension competence of private school pupils to be satisfactory, whereas the overall reading comprehension competence of public school pupils is seen to be disheartening.
Judged on the basis of linguistic background, the overall reading comprehension competence of Nepali mother-tongue pupils is seen to be high, whereas the overall reading comprehension competence of pupils whose mother tongue is not Nepali is seen to be low.
australian_english:
Research title: A Study of How Well Students Who Have Finished Class Six Read and Understand
Researcher: Dibyakala Adhikari
Research supervisor: Prof. Dr. Kedar Prasad Sharma
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University Campus, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur
Academic year: 2061/63
Number of pages: 54+15
Chapters: five
Research procedure: This research paper was put together to meet the requirements of the M.Ed. Nepa. Shi. 598 course under the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.
Looking into how well students who have finished class six read and understand is the main aim of this research work.
As part of this, the job of studying and analysing students in private and public schools of the Kathmandu Valley has been done on the basis of where they come from, gender, the kind of school and their language background.
While gathering material for this research paper, 50 students each from five private and five public schools of the Kathmandu Valley, 100 students from ten schools all up, were taken as the sample for the primary source, while earlier works, reference books, newspapers and various articles make up the secondary material.
The present research work, set out in five chapters, is split respectively into research introduction, theoretical introduction, explanation and analysis, comparative analysis, and conclusions and suggestions.
What the research found:
When the students' ability is worked out as a percentage for overall reading comprehension, and when it is looked at with the mean as the basis, the students' overall reading comprehension ability comes across as satisfactory.
When the seen-passage and unseen-passage reading comprehension ability of all the students is compared, the seen-passage reading comprehension ability comes across as a bit more satisfactory than the unseen-passage reading comprehension ability.
On locality, when you look at the overall reading comprehension ability of the students on the city side, 58 percent of students sitting above the mean and 42 percent below the mean means the overall reading comprehension ability of city students is high, while on the country side 40 percent of students above the mean and 60 percent below the mean means the overall reading comprehension ability of country students is low.
On gender, when you look at the overall reading comprehension ability of the boys, 40 percent of students above the mean and 60 percent below the mean shows the boys' group's reading comprehension ability to be weak, while 60 percent of the girls above the mean and 40 percent below the mean shows the girls' reading comprehension ability to be high.
Going by the kind of school, private school students being mostly above the mean and public school students being mostly below the mean shows the reading comprehension ability of private school students to be satisfactory, while the overall reading comprehension ability of public school students comes across as disappointing.
Going by language background, the overall reading comprehension ability of students with Nepali as their mother tongue comes across as high, while the overall reading comprehension ability of students whose mother tongue is not Nepali comes across as low.
